datatypes-namespace.note: The `DataTypes.<X>DataType` namespace exists now; what is left is that DataTypes.X(...) / new DataTypes.X(...) forms of the integer, float and similar types are not callable or constructable in types (each failing call also makes its expectTypeOf assertion report `Expected 1 arguments`). MySQL-only forms (TINYINT, ZEROFILL) are other-dialect; the rest is real for TypeScript users.

missing-export.note: Type exported by v6 and missing here (Config, AndOperator, OrOperator).

index-hints.note: MySQL index hints (IndexHints export, indexHints option).

expect-type-mismatch.note: A toEqualTypeOf / toMatchTypeOf assertion fails: the inferred type differs from v6 (hook callback arguments, finder and update results, previous(), toJSON, ...). Needs per-assertion triage.

logging-true.note: logging: true is accepted by v6 options, rejected here.

returning-array.note: returning: string[] is accepted by v6 options, rejected here.

option-keys.note: Option key declared by v6 and missing here (fields, isNewRecord, paranoid, duplicating, as, delimiter, length, type, searchPath).

option-keys-other-dialect.note: Option key used only by other dialects (ignoreDuplicates, charset).

query-interface-methods.note: QueryInterface members missing: select, insert, upsert, delete, quoteTable; transaction on RuntimeOwner.

query-interface-arity.note: QueryInterface method called with more arguments than ours accepts (bulkInsert attributes argument).

branded-expression.note: Fn, Literal and Col are not assignable to string-branded attributes and IndexField.

permissive-where.note: Unknown keys in where are accepted here but rejected by v6 on typed models (an @ts-expect-error in the corpus is unused).

define-untyped.note: sequelize.define<M>(name) without attributes, and the model types it yields.

model-typing-misc.note: Cascades and smaller typing differences in model.ts, models/User.ts, connection.ts, sequelize.ts not yet split by cause.
